guard: The reproof selector diffs from the commit the head actually diverged at. Under the pull-request merge ref the head's first parent is the base branch tip, both workflow sites resolve through one shared script, an unresolvable base fails loud instead of selecting nothing, and the resolved base sha is printed beside the record count.
why: PR #1520 diffed from a commit its head already contained, because actions/checkout builds a merge commit for a pull request and the first parent of that commit is the base branch tip. It read 30 changed paths for a four-file change, selected two fixtures guarding commits it merely lacked, and spent 146 minutes producing no fact about its own files.

Each mutation restores one step of that failure: taking the event's base unchanged, normalising it the way the report prescribed (a measured no-op under a merge head), taking the second parent instead of the first, applying the first-parent rule on every event rather than only on a pull request, guessing at an unrecognised event, accepting an empty merge base, and dropping the resolved sha from the transcript that made the wrong selection legible.

mutations.name: the event base is used unchanged, as it was before the fix
mutations.find:
if [ "$event" = pull_request ] || [ "$event" = pull_request_target ]; then
  second="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${head}^2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
mutations.replace:
if false; then
  second="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${head}^2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
mutations.expectRed: a branch behind its base selects only the paths its own diff touches
mutations.cell: a branch behind its base selects only the paths its own diff touches

mutations.name: the base is normalised against the head rather than taken from the first parent
mutations.find:
[ -n "$first" ] || die "HEAD is a merge commit whose first parent does not resolve"
  base="$first"
mutations.replace:
[ -n "$first" ] || die "HEAD is a merge commit whose first parent does not resolve"
  base="$(git merge-base "$base" "$head")"
mutations.expectRed: a branch behind its base selects only the paths its own diff touches
mutations.cell: a branch behind its base selects only the paths its own diff touches

mutations.name: the merge head takes its second parent as the base
mutations.expectRed: a branch behind its base selects only the paths its own diff touches
mutations.cell: a branch behind its base selects only the paths its own diff touches

mutations.name: an unresolvable merge base is accepted instead of refused
mutations.find:
[ -n "$resolved" ] \
    || die "cannot resolve a merge base between $base and $head; a shallow checkout answers this exactly as a repository with no common ancestor does, and diffing against nothing would select zero fixtures and report a green gate that proved nothing (the workflow checks out with fetch-depth: 0)"
  base="$resolved"
mutations.expectRed: an unresolvable merge base fails loud instead of selecting zero fixtures
mutations.cell: an unresolvable merge base fails loud instead of selecting zero fixtures

mutations.name: the first-parent rule is applied on every event, not only on a pull request
mutations.expectRed: a push landing several commits onto a merge head keeps its whole pushed range
mutations.cell: a push landing several commits onto a merge head keeps its whole pushed range

mutations.name: an unrecognised event is guessed at instead of refused
mutations.find: *) die "unknown event '$event'; this selector must not guess which base an unrecognised event implies" ;;
mutations.expectRed: an unknown event is refused rather than guessed at
mutations.cell: an unknown event is refused rather than guessed at

mutations.name: the transcript drops the resolved base sha
mutations.expectRed: the resolved base sha appears in the transcript beside the record count
mutations.cell: the resolved base sha appears in the transcript beside the record count

mutations.name: the plan site resolves its own base instead of calling the shared resolver
mutations.expectRed: the plan site resolves its base through the shared resolver rather than its own copy
mutations.cell: the plan site resolves its base through the shared resolver rather than its own copy

mutations.name: the shard site resolves its own base instead of calling the shared resolver
mutations.find:
base="$(bash scripts/mutation-reproof-base.sh "$EVENT" "$BASE" HEAD)"
          # A file survives a timed-out step even when its environment-file updates do not.
mutations.replace:
base="$BASE"
          # A file survives a timed-out step even when its environment-file updates do not.
mutations.expectRed: the shard site resolves its base through the shared resolver rather than its own copy
mutations.cell: the shard site resolves its base through the shared resolver rather than its own copy

mutations.name: the all-zero base no longer falls back to the first parent
mutations.expectRed: an absent base still falls back to the first parent and says so
mutations.cell: an absent base still falls back to the first parent and says so
